name: Polar and high-latitude ice
basis: Dawn's gamma-ray and neutron spectrometer found ice above 10 percent by mass within a metre of the surface at high latitudes, rising toward the poles. Grades are relative.

name: Ernutet crater organics
basis: Dawn's spectrometer found aliphatic organic material concentrated around Ernutet crater, the one carbon-rich spot on Ceres. Grades are relative.

name: Dark cratered plains
basis: Most of the surface is dark carbonaceous material with ammoniated clays, like a carbonaceous chondrite. Grades are relative.

name: Whole body
basis: A carbonaceous asteroid is hydrated clay and organics like a CI or CM carbonaceous chondrite: up to about 20 percent water by mass, 3 to 4 percent carbon, about 0.1 percent phosphorus. One region stands for the whole body. Grades are relative.

name: Whole body
basis: A stony asteroid is ordinary-chondrite rock: silicates with iron-nickel metal grains, about a fifth to a third of the mass as iron in total and a few percent as free metal. One region stands for the whole body. Grades are relative.

name: Whole body
basis: A metallic asteroid is the core of a broken planetesimal, iron-nickel with cobalt and a few parts per million of platinum-group metals and gold, like an iron meteorite. One region stands for the whole body. Grades are relative.
